The API supports two disruption modes:
mode instructs the scheduler to treat all Pods in the group as separate entities, allowing independent disruption of a single pod from a PodGroup.
mode emphasizes "all-or-nothing" semantics for disruption. It instructs the scheduler that all pods from the PodGroup have to be disrupted together.

The priority of the PodGroup is an authoritative priority for all pods in the group during
events, even when priorities of individual pods forming this PodGroup differ.
The following YAML is an example of a PodGroup configuration that uses the
PriorityClass, which maps to the integer priority value of 1000000. The priority admission controller checks the specification and resolves the priority of the PodGroup to 1000000.

apiVersion: scheduling.k8s.io/v1alpha2
kind: PodGroup
metadata:
  namespace: ns-1
  name: job-1
spec:
  priorityClassName: high-priority
